notes: Raman activities were 12.75 times too large — computed in atomic units and labelled in the unit every other program prints — so water's symmetric stretch now returns 92 rather than 1174 and a spectrum can be compared with Gaussian or ORCA. IR intensities are named a relative quantity, not km/mol. Conformer searches no longer discard candidates before relaxing them: glycine returned 1 conformer when asked for 30 and has 4 within 1.9 kcal/mol. Mirror-image conformers are kept as separate ensemble members, so Boltzmann populations carry their degeneracy (n-butane 34.8% gauche against the old 21%, experiment 30-32%), and an ensemble mixing gas-phase with solvated conformers is flagged. Molecular dynamics no longer counts whole-molecule drift as heat, and a run that fails to conserve energy is reported unconverged. Imported calculations bring the rest of the file with them — thermochemistry, polarizability, NMR tensors, ECD intensities, mode displacements, scan data and the file's own level of theory — and anything still unread is named rather than dropped; an imported MP2 or coupled-cluster job no longer reports its Hartree-Fock energy as the total. A CIF keeps its unit cell and says no symmetry expansion was applied. Engine 0.1.4. Universal, signed and notarized macOS build. See the changelog: https://qemica-lab.com/changelog/
